claim: Iter 143 P7 inter-seed FIRE-decision Cohen's-κ concordance on the GROWING n10_seed_expansion panel (5 GRPO seeds × 15 steps = 75 step-seed decisions). Fresh vein, not in 159 prior P7 rows. Closes brief vein (c) at the DECISION-CONCORDANCE layer: prior iters (iter-99 CV(savings), iter-115 per-seed savings, iter-135 τ-flip band, iter-139 across-seed bootstrap CI) measured COUNT-level reproducibility; iter-143 measures DECISION-level agreement via Cohen's-κ on the 15-step binary FIRE vector for every (τ, seed-pair) cell. τ ∈ {0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90} × C(5,2)=10 pairs + growing-panel slices (k=2,3,4,5). H1 FAIL — strict κ ≥ 0.40 not met: at canonical τ=0.65, mean κ = -0.0516 [SE 0.0558, n_pairs=10]; seeds DISAGREE on which steps fire. H2 PASS — κ(k=2)=-0.216 → κ(k=5)=-0.052, Δ=+0.165 ≫ 0.10 threshold; disagreement is real at every panel size, NOT a small-sample artifact. H3 FAIL — naïve argmax over τ picks τ=0.90 (κ=1.0) by degeneracy (no seed ever fires at τ=0.90 since max zvf in any seed is 0.875); the informative argmax (max κ over τ with FIRE_RATE ≥ 1/15) is τ=0.30 (κ=+0.288), below the iter-135 stable band [0.55, 0.80]. The seeds agree on the marginal fire rate but disagree on which specific steps fire; this is consistent with iter-139 H3 FALSE (trigger is same-step diagnostic, not next-step).
